extension.description: Controls multiple lights (devices) during watching of a video, via a domotica server: - X10 Commander software from Melloware. - HomeSeer. - tenHsServer. - Switch King. - Thinking Home. - HomeWizard. - Domoticz. - HomeGenie. - LightWaveRF.

Bediend meerdere lampen (apparaten) tijdens het bekijken van een video, via een domotica server: - X10 Commander software van Melloware. - HomeSeer. - tenHsServer. - Switch King. - Thinking Home. - HomeWizard. - Domoticz. - HomeGenie. - LightWaveRF.
extension.news: v2.0.0 (2026-11): - Migrated code to Python 3 for modern Kodi (Matrix v19, Nexus v20, Omega v21, Piers v22+). - Replaced obsolete polling loop with event-driven xbmc.Monitor().waitForAbort(). - Upgraded urllib/urllib2 network communication to urllib.request and urllib.parse. - Added explicit network timeouts to prevent Kodi UI blocking. - Converted LightWaveRF UDP broadcasts to bytes (utf-8). - Added modern PO language translation catalogs.
